name: Outlaw Gangster Disciples
description: A subset of the Gangster Disciples street gang, founded in the late 1980s at Chicago's Cabrini-Green housing project by Charles 'Big Chuck' Dorsey. Originally a breakaway faction that openly defied the main GD leadership, Dorsey allied with the Insane Gangster Disciples to consolidate control of Cabrini-Green before he was killed in January 1996. The gang engages in drug trafficking, robbery, extortion, and murder, and has since expanded beyond Cabrini-Green with sets documented in cities including New York, Boston, and St. Louis. The parent organization, Gangster Disciples, has been documented in the U.S. military.
